findings.evidence: Specializations check exactly: `fdBoundary_sub_of_le_one` at `w = ρ + 1` gives `(H - √3/2 - s·(H - √3/2))·I = (1 - s)·(H - √3/2)·I`, the statement of `fdBoundary_sub_rho_add_one_of_mem_Icc_zero_one`; `fdBoundary_sub_of_mem_Icc_three_four` at `w = ρ` gives `(√3/2 + (s-3)(H-√3/2) - √3/2)·I = (s-3)(H-√3/2)·I`, the statement of `fdBoundary_sub_rho_of_mem_Icc_three_four`. The far/near arc proofs are line-for-line the same script (`Real.abs_sin_eq_sin_abs_of_abs_le_pi`, `Real.strictMonoOn_sin`, `nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]`) with `|t - t₀|` replaced by `|t - 3|` / `t - 1`.
findings.fix: Move these five lemmas to `Winding/Basic.lean` — already the declared home of the arc-excision geometry shared by the corner computations (`fdBoundaryArcExcisionHalfWidth`, 'stated once here rather than three times') — as public declarations, and rewrite the seven corner lemmas above as instantiations via `fdBoundary_apply_one`/`fdBoundary_apply_three` (`ρ = fdBoundary H 3`, `ρ + 1 = fdBoundary H 1`, both with `re = ∓1/2`, `im = √3/2`), deleting the duplicated proof bodies. This is the same move the PR already made for the `Winding/I` chord lemmas.
findings.issue: Five general geometry lemmas are proved here but kept `private`, so seven existing special cases in the corner files stay duplicated instead of being derived. `norm_fdBoundary_sub_fdBoundary_arc` (721) generalizes `norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_arc` (Winding/Rho/Geometry.lean:58) and `norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_add_one_arc` (Winding/Rho/AddOne/Geometry.lean:87); `lt_norm_sub_arc_of_far` (732) generalizes `lt_norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_arc_of_far` (Winding/Rho/Value.lean:274) and `lt_norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_add_one_arc_of_far` (Winding/Rho/AddOne/Value.lean:329) — and drops their `δ < 1`; `norm_sub_arc_le_of_near` (750) generalizes `norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_arc_le_of_near` (Winding/Rho/Value.lean:290) and covers the `δR < 1` use of `norm_fdBoundary_sub_rho_add_one_arc_le` in `norm_le_of_near_rho_add_one` (Winding/Rho/AddOne/Value.lean:370); `fdBoundary_sub_of_le_one` (213) generalizes `fdBoundary_sub_rho_add_one_of_mem_Icc_zero_one` (Winding/Rho/AddOne/Geometry.lean:75); `fdBoundary_sub_of_mem_Icc_three_four` (224) generalizes `fdBoundary_sub_rho_of_mem_Icc_three_four` (Winding/Rho/Geometry.lean:71).

summary: Hypotheses on both public pairs are at the natural level and all used. But the new file proves the general arc-chord and vertical-shift geometry as `private` lemmas while the corner files keep their `t₀ = 3` / `t₀ = 1` (and `w = ρ` / `ρ + 1`) copies of the same proofs — the general result should be public and the special cases derived from it, as was done for the deleted `Winding/I` copies.
